author: Rainstruck
body:
The Ravish Brothers have a couple of projects ahead of them, and after we finish a tournament map, we are going to do another CTW map. So we want to open up to the ideas of the public, and we want to know what is your ideal CTW map?

We will try to incorporate as many of the ideas as we can, and we will try to make this the best CTW map ever.

Thanks,
Riley and Cal

replies.author: BourbonBonobo
replies.body:
Just make CTW Simple... Not all these crazy, Massive maps that take up a bunch of data and cause a Shit ton of lag... Make it Simple.. Doesn't have to be flat or anything... It has to be simple to allow smooth gameplay.. The reason IMO i don't like CTW is because I believe lot's of maps don't always make smooth gameplay... Honestly, I'd like a flat map, where people can build their own defenses... Rush easier... not have to worry about destroying things like decorations and such.. Take the map... I believe its called like vesper or something.. Now I know this isn't a CTW map, but that map has possibly the smoothest gameplay Iv'e ever played on.. There's like no lag... Tons of room to build defenses... PVP... What if you modeled a CTW like that... It's my opinion... you don't have to take this into full consideration.. I just think Smooth Gameplay is what could make CTW memorable

Thanks, Aero
